name: Trolls & Légendes
blurb: Fantasy literature and costume festival in Mons, Belgium, blending books, comics, manga, games and epic music.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Trolls & Légendes in Mons on March 26, 27 and 28, 2027'; corroborated by the Lotto Mons Expo venue listing and L'Agenda Geek, both giving 26–28 March 2027 at Lotto Mons Expo, Mons.

notes: The site's /en/guests/ path (and every other sub-path tried) serves the same homepage shell rather than distinct content, so no guest list could be found yet — the homepage itself says booth applications for the market/publishing/games area only just opened, consistent with guests not being announced yet this far out. Previous (Summer/August 2026) edition is already over as of this 2026-10-05 check. The batch note's location for a different con in this run (Made in Asia) wrongly cited 'Lotto Mons Expo' — that venue actually belongs to this convention, confirmed here via the venue's own listing.
